annotations.title: Compare a limited company and sole trader

description: Compare take-home pay as a sole trader with running the same profit through a limited company (salary plus dividends, corporation tax and accountancy cost) for a tax year, with the annual difference and an approximate break-even profit.

accountancyCost.description: Extra accountancy cost of a company a year; defaults to 2000

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.

name: compare_limited_company_and_sole_trader
